一、React Router 相关 ​

1. React-router几种路由模式 ​

React Router 支持三种路由模式，每种模式都有其独特的应用场景和实现原理，选择时需要根据项目需求、服务器配置和目标平台综合考虑。

Hash 模式

jsx
import { HashRouter } from 'react-router-dom';

<HashRouter>
  <Routes>
    <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
    <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
    <Route path="/user/:id" element={<User />} />
  </Routes>
</HashRouter>
1
2
3
4
5
6
7
8
9
  • URL 格式：http://example.com/#/path
  • 优点：兼容性好，不需要服务器配置，支持低版本浏览器，部署简单
  • 缺点：URL 带有 #，不够美观，SEO 不友好
  • 原理：监听 hashchange 事件，监听 URL hash 的变化，hash 变化不会触发页面刷新

History 模式

jsx
import { BrowserRouter } from 'react-router-dom';

<BrowserRouter>
  <Routes>
    <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
    <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
    <Route path="/user/:id" element={<User />} />
  </Routes>
</BrowserRouter>

  • URL 格式：http://example.com/path
  • 优点：URL 美观，符合用户习惯，对 SEO 友好
  • 缺点：需要服务器配置支持404回退（所有路由请求都指向 index.html）
  • 原理：使用 HTML5 History API（pushState、replaceState、popstate）

Memory 模式（静态路由）

jsx
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';

<MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/home', '/user/123', { pathname: '/about' }]}>
  <Routes>
    <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
    <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
    <Route path="/user/:id" element={<User />} />
  </Routes>
</MemoryRouter>

  • 路由存储在内存中，不读取或写入浏览器地址栏
  • 常用于测试环境、非浏览器环境的 React 应用（如 React Native、单元测试）
  • 不会触发浏览器地址栏变化，适合需要完全控制历史的场景

实战案例：如何选择路由模式

jsx
// 场景1：后端不支持路由配置，选择 Hash 模式
// 适用：旧项目、共享主机、无法修改服务器配置
// 示例：客户要求快速上线，不提供服务器配置权限
function OldProjectApp() {
  return (
    <HashRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
      </Routes>
    </HashRouter>
  );
}

// 场景2：需要 SEO 优化，选择 History 模式
// 适用：官网、博客、企业站等需要搜索引擎收录
// 示例：电商网站、商品详情页需要被 Google 收录
function EcommerceApp() {
  return (
    <BrowserRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/product/:id" element={<ProductDetail />} />
        <Route path="/category/:categoryId" element={<Category />} />
      </Routes>
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

// 场景3：React Native 或测试环境，选择 Memory 模式
// 适用：移动端、单元测试、服务端渲染
function TestApp() {
  return (
    <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/home', '/about']} initialIndex={0}>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/home" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
      </Routes>
    </MemoryRouter>
  );
}

// Nginx 服务器配置（History 模式必需）
// nginx.conf
// server {
//   location / {
//     try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
//   }
// }

2. React-router路由形式 ​

声明式路由

jsx
import { Routes, Route, Link } from 'react-router-dom';

function App() {
  return (
    <>
      <nav>
        <Link to="/home">首页</Link>
        <Link to="/about">关于</Link>
      </nav>

      <Routes>
        <Route path="/home" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
        <Route path="/user/:id" element={<User />} />
      </Routes>
    </>
  );
}

编程式路由

jsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

function LoginButton() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLogin = () => {
    // 跳转并传递参数
    navigate('/home', { replace: true });

    // 传递 state
    navigate('/user/123', { state: { from: 'login' } });
  };

  return <button onClick={handleLogin}>登录</button>;
}

// 获取路由参数
function User() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const location = useLocation();

  console.log('用户ID:', id);
  console.log('路由状态:', location.state);
}

3. React-router详解 ​

核心组件详解表格

组件作用使用场景
BrowserRouter/HashRouter路由容器，提供路由上下文包裹整个应用
Routes路由匹配容器，根据路径渲染对应 Route包含所有 Route
Route路由配置，定义路径和组件的映射定义具体路由
Link/NavLink声明式导航，生成 a 标签替代 a 标签
Navigate编程式导航，组件形式重定向、自动跳转
Outlet嵌套路由渲染出口父组件中渲染子路由
useParams获取动态路由参数读取 :id 这样的参数
useSearchParams操作查询参数读写 ?key=value
useLocation获取当前路由信息pathname、search、state
useNavigate编程式导航js 中跳转
useRoutes配置文件方式定义路由代替 Routes+Route

路由参数详解

jsx
// 动态路由参数 - 获取 URL 中的动态部分
<Route path="/user/:userId/post/:postId" element={<Post />} />

function Post() {
  const { userId, postId } = useParams();
  // URL: /user/123/post/456
  // userId = '123', postId = '456'
  return <div>用户 {userId} 的帖子 {postId}</div>;
}

// 查询参数 - 获取 ?key=value
function Search() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const keyword = searchParams.get('keyword');  // 获取单个参数
  const page = searchParams.get('page') || 1;
  const category = searchParams.getAll('category');  // 获取同名多个值

  const handleSearch = (term) => {
    setSearchParams({ keyword: term, page: '1' });
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    searchParams.set('page', newPage.toString());
    setSearchParams(searchParams);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    searchParams.reset();
    setSearchParams(searchParams);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p>关键词: {keyword}, 页码: {page}, 分类: {category.join(',')}</p>
      <button onClick={() => handleSearch('react')}>搜索 react</button>
      <button onClick={() => handlePageChange(2)}>第2页</button>
      <button onClick={handleReset}>重置</button>
    </div>
  );
}

路由守卫完整实现

jsx
// 1. 基础权限守卫
function RequireAuth({ children }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (loading) {
    return <Spinner />;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    // 重定向到登录页，携带来源路径
    return <Navigate to="/login" state={{ from: location }} replace />;
  }

  return children;
}

// 2. 角色权限守卫
function RequireRole({ children, allowedRoles }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  if (!user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  if (!allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/403" replace />;
  }

  return children;
}

// 3. 多条件守卫
function ConditionalRoute({ children, conditions }) {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  for (const condition of conditions) {
    if (!condition.check(user)) {
      return <Navigate to={condition.redirect} replace />;
    }
  }

  return children;
}

// 使用守卫
function App() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
      <Route path="/public" element={<Public />} />

      {/* 需要登录 */}
      <Route
        path="/dashboard"
        element={
          <RequireAuth>
            <Dashboard />
          </RequireAuth>
        }
      />

      {/* 需要特定角色 */}
      <Route
        path="/admin"
        element={
          <RequireAuth>
            <RequireRole allowedRoles={['admin']}>
              <AdminPanel />
            </RequireRole>
          </RequireAuth>
        }
      />

      {/* 条件守卫示例 */}
      <Route
        path="/premium"
        element={
          <ConditionalRoute
            conditions={[
              { check: (user) => !!user, redirect: '/login' },
              { check: (user) => user.isSubscribed, redirect: '/subscribe' },
              { check: (user) => user.credits > 0, redirect: '/buy-credits' }
            ]}
          >
            <PremiumContent />
          </ConditionalRoute>
        }
      />
    </Routes>
  );
}

4. React-router性能优化手段 ​

路由懒加载完整方案

jsx
import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Routes, Route } from 'react-router-dom';

// 方法1: 直接懒加载
const Home = lazy(() => import('./pages/Home'));
const About = lazy(() => import('./pages/About'));
const Dashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/Dashboard'));
const Settings = lazy(() => import('./pages/Settings'));
const Users = lazy(() => import('./pages/Users'));
const Products = lazy(() => import('./pages/Products'));
const NotFound = lazy(() => import('./pages/NotFound'));

// 方法2: 使用 webpackChunkName 优化打包
const Home = lazy(() => import(
  /* webpackChunkName: "home" */
  /* webpackPrefetch: true */
  './pages/Home'
));

// 加载组件
function LoadingSpinner({ text = '加载中...' }) {
  return (
    <div className="loading-container">
      <div className="spinner"></div>
      <p>{text}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// 错误边界组件
class RouteErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  state = { hasError: false, error: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error('路由加载错误:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="error-container">
          <h2>页面加载失败</h2>
          <p>{this.state.error?.message}</p>
          <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>刷新页面</button>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

function App() {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <Suspense fallback={<LoadingSpinner text="页面加载中..." />}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
          <Route path="/dashboard/*" element={<DashboardRoutes />} />
          <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
        </Routes>
      </Suspense>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

// Dashboard 子路由也懒加载
function DashboardRoutes() {
  const DashboardHome = lazy(() => import('./pages/dashboard/Home'));
  const DashboardAnalytics = lazy(() => import('./pages/dashboard/Analytics'));
  const DashboardSettings = lazy(() => import('./pages/dashboard/Settings'));

  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route index element={<DashboardHome />} />
      <Route path="analytics" element={<DashboardAnalytics />} />
      <Route path="settings" element={<DashboardSettings />} />
    </Routes>
  );
}

预加载组件实现

jsx
import { lazy, useCallback } from 'react';

// 预加载管理器
const preloadCache = new Map();

function preloadRoute(path) {
  if (preloadCache.has(path)) {
    return preloadCache.get(path);
  }

  const promise = import(/* webpackChunkName: "[request]" */ `./pages/${path}`)
    .then(module => module.default)
    .catch(err => {
      console.error(`预加载失败: ${path}`, err);
      preloadCache.delete(path);
    });

  preloadCache.set(path, promise);
  return promise;
}

// 预加载链接组件
function PreloadLink({ to, children, onMouseEnter: onHover, ...props }) {
  const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(() => {
    // 鼠标悬停时预加载
    const path = to.replace('/', '');
    if (path) {
      preloadRoute(path);
    }
    onHover?.();
  }, [to]);

  return (
    <Link to={to} onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter} {...props}>
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}

// 使用
function Navigation() {
  return (
    <nav>
      <PreloadLink to="/dashboard">仪表盘</PreloadLink>
      <PreloadLink to="/users">用户管理</PreloadLink>
      <PreloadLink to="/products">商品管理</PreloadLink>
    </nav>
  );
}

// 基于滚动视口预加载
function usePreloadOnViewport(entry) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const path = entry.target.dataset.preload;
            if (path) {
              preloadRoute(path);
            }
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.5 }
    );

    if (entry) {
      observer.observe(entry);
    }

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [entry]);
}

路由缓存优化

jsx
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Routes, Route, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

// 路由配置
const routeConfig = [
  { path: '/', component: Home },
  { path: '/about', component: About },
  { path: '/dashboard', component: Dashboard },
  { path: '/settings', component: Settings },
  { path: '/users', component: Users },
  { path: '/products', component: Products },
];

// 缓存组件实例
const componentCache = new Map();

function CachedRoute({ path, component: Component }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const cacheKey = `${path}-${location.key}`;

  const cachedComponent = useMemo(() => {
    if (!componentCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      componentCache.set(cacheKey, <Component />);
    }
    // 限制缓存大小
    if (componentCache.size > 10) {
      const firstKey = componentCache.keys().next().value;
      componentCache.delete(firstKey);
    }
    return componentCache.get(cacheKey);
  }, [cacheKey]);

  return cachedComponent;
}

// 使用
function App() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      {routeConfig.map(({ path, component }) => (
        <Route
          key={path}
          path={path}
          element={<CachedRoute path={path} component={component} />}
        />
      ))}
    </Routes>
  );
}

二、React Hooks 相关 ​

5. 常用的hook ​

基础 Hooks 详解表格

Hook作用核心点常见错误
useState状态管理setState 是异步的，不会立即更新直接修改对象/数组
useEffect副作用处理依赖数组控制执行时机依赖遗漏、清理函数缺失
useContext跨组件传值不支持订阅，会导致重渲染Context 过于庞大

高级 Hooks 详解表格

Hook作用核心点使用场景
useReducer复杂状态管理reducer 模式表单、多状态联动
useCallback函数缓存配合 React.memo传递给子组件的函数
useMemo计算结果缓存避免重复计算复杂计算、派生数据
useRefDOM 引用/可变值更新不触发重渲染定时器、previous value
useImperativeHandle自定义暴露方法配合 forwardRef父组件调用子组件方法
useLayoutEffect同步副作用阻塞渲染DOM 测量、动画
useDebugValueDevTools 调试自定义 Hook库开发

Hooks 完整示例

jsx
import { useState, useEffect, useContext, useReducer, useCallback,
         useMemo, useRef, useImperativeHandle, useLayoutEffect,
         useDebugValue, createContext, useContext } from 'react';

// useState 完整示例
function UseStateDemo() {
  // 基本类型
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  // 对象类型
  const [user, setUser] = useState({
    name: '',
    age: 0,
    hobbies: []
  });

  // 惰性初始化 - 避免初始值计算在每次渲染时执行
  const [data, setData] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('data');
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : initialData;
  });

  // 函数式更新 - 基于前一个状态
  const increment = () => setCount(prev => prev + 1);
  const decrement = () => setCount(prev => prev - 1);

  // 对象更新 - 需要展开旧对象
  const updateUser = (field, value) => {
    setUser(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value
    }));
  };

  // 数组添加
  const addHobby = (hobby) => {
    setUser(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      hobbies: [...prev.hobbies, hobby]
    }));
  };

  // 数组删除
  const removeHobby = (index) => {
    setUser(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      hobbies: prev.hobbies.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p>计数: {count}</p>
      <button onClick={increment}>+</button>
      <button onClick={decrement}>-</button>

      <p>用户名: {user.name}</p>
      <input
        value={user.name}
        onChange={e => updateUser('name', e.target.value)}
      />

      <p>年龄: {user.age}</p>
      <input
        type="number"
        value={user.age}
        onChange={e => updateUser('age', parseInt(e.target.value))}
      />

      <p>爱好: {user.hobbies.join(', ')}</p>
      <button onClick={() => addHobby('阅读')}>添加爱好</button>
    </div>
  );
}

6. React hook 用法详解 ​

useState 深度剖析

jsx
// 1. 批量更新机制
function BatchUpdateDemo() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');

  const handleBatchUpdate = () => {
    // 在 React 事件处理中，多个 setState 会批量处理
    setCount(1);  // 被批量
    setCount(2);  // 被批量
    setCount(3);  // 最终只会渲染一次，count = 3
    setName('John');  // 也会被批量

    // 使用函数式更新确保基于最新状态
    setCount(prev => prev + 1);
    setCount(prev => prev + 1);
    setCount(prev => prev + 1);  // count 最终 = 3
  };

  // 2. setTimeout 中是同步更新
  useEffect(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCount(100);  // 同步更新，组件立即重渲染
    }, 1000);
  }, []);

  // 3. 状态回退/前进
  const [history, setHistory] = useState([0]);
  const [pointer, setPointer] = useState(0);

  const goBack = () => {
    if (pointer > 0) {
      setPointer(p => p - 1);
    }
  };

  const goForward = () => {
    if (pointer < history.length - 1) {
      setPointer(p => p + 1);
    }
  };

  const currentCount = history[pointer];
  console.log('当前状态:', currentCount, '历史:', history, '指针:', pointer);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>计数: {currentCount}</p>
      <button onClick={() => {
        const newHistory = [...history.slice(0, pointer + 1), currentCount + 1];
        setHistory(newHistory);
        setPointer(newHistory.length - 1);
      }}>前进</button>
      <button onClick={goBack}>后退</button>
    </div>
  );
}

useEffect 深度剖析

jsx
// 1. 依赖数组的秘密
function EffectDependenciesDemo() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');

  // 每次渲染都执行
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('每次渲染都执行');
  });

  // 仅挂载时执行一次
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('仅挂载时执行');
    // 清理函数在卸载时执行
    return () => {
      console.log('清理：仅挂载时执行');
    };
  }, []);  // 空依赖数组

  // count 变化时执行
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('count 变化了:', count);
  }, [count]);  // count 作为依赖

  // name 或 count 变化时执行
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('name 或 count 变化了');
    console.log('name:', name, 'count:', count);
  }, [name, count]);

  // 2. 常见错误
  useEffect(() => {
    // ❌ 错误：id 变化了但没有在依赖数组中
    fetchData(id);
  }, []);  // 应该添加 id 到依赖数组

  // ✅ 正确
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData(id);
  }, [id]);

  // 3. 清理函数的重要性
  useEffect(() => {
    // 订阅
    const subscription = subscribe(handleMessage);

    // 定时器
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      fetchNewData();
    }, 5000);

    // 事件监听
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    // 返回清理函数
    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
      clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    };
  }, []);

  // 4. 异步 useEffect（常见错误）
  useEffect(() => {
    // ❌ 错误：useEffect 不能直接返回 async 函数
    const fetchData = async () => {
      const res = await fetch(url);
      setData(await res.json());
    };
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  // ✅ 正确：IIFE 或分离函数
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      const res = await fetch(url);
      setData(await res.json());
    };
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  // 或
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const res = await fetch(url);
      setData(await res.json());
    })();
  }, []);

  // 或使用 .then
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(url)
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(setData);
  }, []);
}

闭包陷阱深度解析与解决方案

jsx
// 场景1：定时器闭包陷阱
function TimerWithClosureIssue() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      // ❌ 闭包陷阱：count 永远是初始值 0
      console.log('Count:', count);
      setCount(count + 1);
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []); // 依赖数组为空

  return <div>{count}</div>; // count 永远是 1
}

// ✅ 解决方案1：函数式更新
function TimerSolution1() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCount(prev => {
        console.log('Count:', prev);
        return prev + 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return <div>{count}</div>;
}

// ✅ 解决方案2：使用 ref 存储最新值
function TimerSolution2() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const countRef = useRef(count);

  // 保持 ref 和 state 同步
  useEffect(() => {
    countRef.current = count;
  }, [count]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      console.log('Count:', countRef.current);
      setCount(countRef.current + 1);
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return <div>{count}</div>;
}

// 场景2：useEffect 依赖对象
function EffectWithObjectIssue() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: 'John', age: 30 });

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('User changed:', user);
    fetchUserData(user);
  }, [user]); // ❌ user 对象每次都是新的引用

  // ❌ 每次渲染都会触发 useEffect
  return (
    <button onClick={() => setUser({ ...user })}>更新用户</button>
  );
}

// ✅ 解决方案：使用 useMemo 或拆分属性
function EffectWithMemoizedDeps() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: 'John', age: 30 });

  // 使用 useMemo 或只依赖需要的属性
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Name changed:', user.name);
    fetchUserByName(user.name);
  }, [user.name]);

  // 或者使用 useRef 存储不变的依赖
  const optionsRef = useRef({ theme: 'dark', language: 'zh' });

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Options:', optionsRef.current);
  }, []); // optionsRef.current 永远不变
}

// 场景3：async/await 与 useEffect
function AsyncEffectIssue() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(async () => {
    // ❌ 错误：async 函数返回的是 Promise，不是清理函数
    const res = await fetch('/api/data');
    setData(await res.json());
  }, []);

  // ✅ 正确：使用 IIFE
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const res = await fetch('/api/data');
      setData(await res.json());
    })();
  }, []);

  // ✅ 或者使用 .then
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/data')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(setData);
  }, []);
}

useCallback 和 useMemo 高级用法

jsx
// useCallback 典型使用场景
function UseCallbackDemo({ userId }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  // ✅ 场景1：传递给 memoized 子组件
  const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
    console.log('Clicked');
  }, []);

  // ✅ 场景2：作为 useEffect 的依赖
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser(userId);
  }, [userId, handleClick]);

  // ❌ 场景3：过度使用（不必要的 useCallback）
  const handleChange = useCallback((e) => {
    setQuery(e.target.value);  // 这里其实不需要 useCallback
  }, []);

  return (
    <div>
      <MemoizedButton onClick={handleClick} />
      <input value={query} onChange={handleChange} />
    </div>
  );
}

// useMemo 高级用法
function UseMemoDemo({ items, filter }) {
  // ✅ 缓存计算结果
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    console.log('计算 filteredItems');
    return items.filter(item =>
      item.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())
    );
  }, [items, filter]);

  // ✅ 缓存派生数据
  const statistics = useMemo(() => {
    if (filteredItems.length === 0) return null;
    return {
      count: filteredItems.length,
      average: filteredItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0) / filteredItems.length,
      max: Math.max(...filteredItems.map(item => item.price)),
      min: Math.min(...filteredItems.map(item => item.price)),
    };
  }, [filteredItems]);

  // ✅ 缓存复杂对象
  const config = useMemo(() => ({
    theme: 'dark',
    language: 'zh',
    pagination: {
      pageSize: 20,
      showSizeChanger: true,
    },
    sorting: {
      defaultSortField: 'createdAt',
      defaultSortOrder: 'descend',
    }
  }), []);

  // ✅ 缓存 JSX
  const listHeader = useMemo(() => (
    <div className="list-header">
      <h2>列表标题</h2>
      <span>共 {filteredItems.length} 项</span>
    </div>
  ), [filteredItems.length]);

  return (
    <div>
      {listHeader}
      <ConfigContext.Provider value={config}>
        <ItemList items={filteredItems} statistics={statistics} />
      </ConfigContext.Provider>
    </div>
  );
}

7. React自定义hook ​

自定义Hook规则

  • 名称必须以 use 开头，这是 React 强制规则
  • 只能在函数组件或其他自定义Hook中调用
  • 共享的是逻辑，而不是状态（每个组件调用都会独立运行）
  • 自定义 Hook 是提取组件逻辑的推荐方式

常用自定义Hook示例

jsx
// 1. 获取窗口尺寸
function useWindowSize() {
  const [size, setSize] = useState({
    width: window.innerWidth,
    height: window.innerHeight
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setSize({
        width: window.innerWidth,
        height: window.innerHeight
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  return size;
}

// 使用
function App() {
  const { width, height } = useWindowSize();
  return <div>窗口尺寸: {width} x {height}</div>;
}

// 2. 异步数据获取
function useFetch(url) {
  const [state, setState] = useState({
    data: null,
    loading: true,
    error: null
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();

    fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => setState({ data, loading: false, error: null }))
      .catch(error => {
        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') {
          setState({ data: null, loading: false, error });
        }
      });

    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [url]);

  return state;
}

// 使用
function UserProfile({ userId }) {
  const { data: user, loading, error } = useFetch(`/api/users/${userId}`);

  if (loading) return <div>加载中...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>错误: {error.message}</div>;
  return <div>{user.name}</div>;
}

// 3. 表单处理
function useForm(initialValues) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState(initialValues);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
  };

  const reset = () => {
    setValues(initialValues);
    setErrors({});
  };

  return { values, errors, handleChange, setValues, setErrors, reset };
}

      <input name="username" value={values.username} onChange={handleChange} />
      <input name="password" type="password" value={values.password} onChange={handleChange} />
      <button type="submit">登录</button>
    </form>
  );
}

// 4. 本地存储
function useLocalStorage(key, initialValue) {
  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue;
    } catch (error) {
      return initialValue;
    }
  });

  const setValue = (value) => {
    try {
      const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value;
      setStoredValue(valueToStore);
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
    }
  };

  return [storedValue, setValue];
}

// 使用
function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useLocalStorage('theme', 'light');
  return <div theme={theme}>{theme}</div>;
}

// 5. 媒体查询
function useMediaQuery(query) {
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(
    () => window.matchMedia(query).matches
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia(query);
    const handler = (e) => setMatches(e.matches);

    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handler);
  }, [query]);

  return matches;
}

// 使用
function App() {
  const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)');
  return <div>{isMobile ? '移动端' : '桌面端'}</div>;
}

高级自定义Hook示例

jsx
// 6. 防抖 Hook
function useDebounce(value, delay = 500) {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

// 使用 - 搜索防抖
function SearchComponent() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const debouncedQuery = useDebounce(query, 300);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (debouncedQuery) {
      fetchResults(debouncedQuery);
    }
  }, [debouncedQuery]);

  return (
    <input
      value={query}
      onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
      placeholder="搜索..."
    />
  );
}

// 7. 节流 Hook
function useThrottle(value, interval = 500) {
  const [throttledValue, setThrottledValue] = useState(value);
  const lastUpdated = useRef(Date.now());

  useEffect(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastUpdated.current >= interval) {
      lastUpdated.current = now;
      setThrottledValue(value);
    } else {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        lastUpdated.current = Date.now();
        setThrottledValue(value);
      }, interval - (now - lastUpdated.current));

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [value, interval]);

  return throttledValue;
}

// 8. 获取上一个值 Hook
function usePrevious(value) {
  const ref = useRef();

  useEffect(() => {
    ref.current = value;
  }, [value]);

  return ref.current;
}

// 使用 - 检测值变化
function PreviousValueDemo() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const previousCount = usePrevious(count);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>当前值: {count}</p>
      <p>上一个值: {previousCount}</p>
      <button onClick={() => setCount(c => c + 1)}>增加</button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 9. 开关状态 Hook
function useToggle(initialValue = false) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialValue);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    setValue(v => !v);
  }, []);

  const setTrue = useCallback(() => {
    setValue(true);
  }, []);

  const setFalse = useCallback(() => {
    setValue(false);
  }, []);

  return { value, toggle, setTrue, setFalse };
}

// 使用
function ToggleDemo() {
  const { value, toggle, setTrue, setFalse } = useToggle(false);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>状态: {value ? '开' : '关'}</p>
      <button onClick={toggle}>切换</button>
      <button onClick={setTrue}>打开</button>
      <button onClick={setFalse}>关闭</button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 10. 点击外部检测 Hook
function useClickOutside(ref, handler) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (event) => {
      if (!ref.current || ref.current.contains(event.target)) {
        return;
      }
      handler(event);
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', listener);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', listener);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('click', listener);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', listener);
    };
  }, [ref, handler]);
}

// 使用 - 下拉菜单
function Dropdown() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  useClickOutside(dropdownRef, () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  });

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef}>
      <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}>菜单</button>
      {isOpen && (
        <ul className="dropdown-menu">
          <li>选项1</li>
          <li>选项2</li>
          <li>选项3</li>
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// 11. 定时器 Hook（解决闭包陷阱）
function useInterval(callback, delay) {
  const savedCallback = useRef();

  useEffect(() => {
    savedCallback.current = callback;
  }, [callback]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (delay === null) return;

    const tick = () => savedCallback.current();
    const id = setInterval(tick, delay);

    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [delay]);
}

// 使用 - 正常计数的定时器
function IntervalDemo() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(true);

  useInterval(() => {
    setCount(c => c + 1);
  }, isRunning ? 1000 : null);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>计数: {count}</p>
      <button onClick={() => setIsRunning(!isRunning)}>
        {isRunning ? '暂停' : '继续'}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 12. 异步状态管理 Hook
function useAsync(asyncFn, dependencies = []) {
  const [state, setState] = useState({
    loading: true,
    error: null,
    data: null
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    setState({ loading: true, error: null, data: null });

    asyncFn()
      .then(data => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setState({ loading: false, error: null, data });
        }
      })
      .catch(error => {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setState({ loading: false, error, data: null });
        }
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, dependencies);

  return state;
}

// 使用
function AsyncDataDemo({ userId }) {
  const { loading, error, data: user } = useAsync(
    () => fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`).then(r => r.json()),
    [userId]
  );

  if (loading) return <div>加载中...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>错误: {error.message}</div>;
  if (!user) return <div>无数据</div>;

  return <div>用户名: {user.name}</div>;
}

三、React 高级特性 ​

8. React反向继承 ​

什么是反向继承

  • HOC 的一种实现方式
  • 包装组件后，返回的组件继承自被包装组件
  • 可以访问组件的内部状态和生命周期

基本实现

jsx
// 高阶组件
function withLogger(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    componentDidMount() {
      console.log('组件挂载了');
      super.componentDidMount();
    }

    render() {
      console.log('渲染中...');
      return super.render();
    }
  };
}

// 使用
@withLogger
class MyComponent extends React.Component {
  render() {
    return <div>Hello</div>;
  }
}

// 1. 渲染劫持
function HOC(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    render() {
      if (this.props.isLoading) {
        return <div>加载中...</div>;
      }
      return super.render();
    }
  };
}

// 2. 修改生命周期
function withTimeout(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    componentDidMount() {
      this.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        console.log('超时处理');
      }, 5000);
      super.componentDidMount();
    }

    componentWillUnmount() {
      clearTimeout(this.timeoutId);
      super.componentWillUnmount();
    }
  };
}

9. 高阶组件用法及封装 ​

属性代理 HOC 完整示例

jsx
// 1. props 增强 HOC
function withPropsEnhancement(WrappedComponent) {
  return function EnhancedComponent(props) {
    // 添加默认 props
    const enhancedProps = {
      ...props,
      defaultClassName: 'default-styles',
      defaultId: `element-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
      onError: (error) => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        props.onError?.(error);
      },
    };

    return (
      <div className="enhanced-wrapper">
        <WrappedComponent {...enhancedProps} />
      </div>
    );
  };
}

// 2. 条件渲染 HOC
function withCondition(WrappedComponent, condition, FallbackComponent = null) {
  return function ConditionalComponent(props) {
    if (condition(props)) {
      return <WrappedComponent {...props} />;
    }
    return FallbackComponent ? <FallbackComponent {...props} /> : null;
  };
}

// 使用
const AdminOnly = withCondition(
  AdminPanel,
  (props) => props.user?.role === 'admin',
  () => <div>权限不足</div>
);

// 3. 动画 HOC
function withAnimation(WrappedComponent, animationConfig = {}) {
  return function AnimatedComponent(props) {
    const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    const ref = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
        ([entry]) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            setIsVisible(true);
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        },
        { threshold: 0.1 }
      );

      if (ref.current) {
        observer.observe(ref.current);
      }

      return () => observer.disconnect();
    }, []);

    const animationStyle = {
      opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0,
      transform: isVisible ? 'translateY(0)' : 'translateY(20px)',
      transition: `all ${animationConfig.duration || 0.5}s ease`,
      transitionDelay: `${animationConfig.delay || 0}s`,
    };

    return (
      <div ref={ref} style={animationStyle}>
        <WrappedComponent {...props} />
      </div>
    );
  };
}

// 4. 表单验证 HOC
function withValidation(WrappedComponent, validationRules) {
  return function ValidatedComponent(props) {
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
    const [touched, setTouched] = useState({});

    const validate = useCallback((name, value) => {
      const rule = validationRules[name];
      if (!rule) return '';

      if (rule.required && !value) {
        return rule.message || `${name} 不能为空`;
      }

      if (rule.pattern && !rule.pattern.test(value)) {
        return rule.message || `${name} 格式不正确`;
      }

      if (rule.validator) {
        return rule.validator(value);
      }

      return '';
    }, [validationRules]);

    const handleBlur = (name) => {
      setTouched(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: true }));
      const error = validate(name, props[name]);
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: error }));
    };

    const validateAll = () => {
      const newErrors = {};
      let isValid = true;

      Object.keys(validationRules).forEach(name => {
        const error = validate(name, props[name]);
        if (error) {
          newErrors[name] = error;
          isValid = false;
        }
      });

      setErrors(newErrors);
      return isValid;
    };

    const clearErrors = () => {
      setErrors({});
      setTouched({});
    };

    return (
      <WrappedComponent
        {...props}
        errors={errors}
        touched={touched}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        validateAll={validateAll}
        clearErrors={clearErrors}
      />
    );
  };
}

// 5. 拖拽 HOC
function withDrag(WrappedComponent) {
  return function DraggableComponent(props) {
    const [position, setPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
    const dragRef = useRef({ startX: 0, startY: 0, initialX: 0, initialY: 0 });

    const handleMouseDown = (e) => {
      setIsDragging(true);
      dragRef.current = {
        startX: e.clientX,
        startY: e.clientY,
        initialX: position.x,
        initialY: position.y,
      };
    };

    useEffect(() => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
      const deltaX = e.clientX - dragRef.current.startX;
      const deltaY = e.clientY - dragRef.current.startY;
      setPosition({
        x: dragRef.current.initialX + deltaX,
        y: dragRef.current.initialY + deltaY,
      });
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDragging(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
    }, [isDragging]);

    return (
      <div
        style={{
          position: 'absolute',
          left: position.x,
          top: position.y,
          cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
        }}
        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
      >
        <WrappedComponent {...props} position={position} isDragging={isDragging} />
      </div>
    );
  };
}

// 使用示例
const DraggleBox = withDrag(({ position, isDragging }) => (
  <div style={{
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    background: isDragging ? '#ff6b6b' : '#4ecdc4',
    borderRadius: 8,
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    color: 'white',
    userSelect: 'none',
  }}>
    拖动我
  </div>
));

反向继承 HOC 完整示例

jsx
// 反向继承 HOC - 可以劫持原组件的渲染过程
function withLogger(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    componentDidMount() {
      console.log('组件即将挂载:', this.constructor.name);
      super.componentDidMount();
    }

    componentWillUnmount() {
      console.log('组件即将卸载:', this.constructor.name);
      super.componentWillUnmount();
    }

    render() {
      console.log('渲染:', this.constructor.name);
      return super.render();
    }
  };
}

// 渲染劫持示例
function withLoading(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    render() {
      if (this.props.isLoading) {
        return (
          <div className="loading-spinner">
            <div className="spinner"></div>
            <p>加载中...</p>
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (this.props.error) {
        return (
          <div className="error-message">
            <p>出错了: {this.props.error.message}</p>
            <button onClick={this.props.onRetry}>重试</button>
          </div>
        );
      }

      return super.render();
    }
  };
}

// 修改子组件示例
function withChildrenModifier(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    render() {
      const elements = super.render();

      if (!elements) return elements;

      // 给所有子元素添加额外属性
      const modifiedChildren = React.Children.map(elements.props.children, child => {
        if (React.isValidElement(child)) {
          return React.cloneElement(child, {
            'data-hierarchy': 'modified',
            onMouseEnter: (e) => {
              // 保留原有事件
              child.props.onMouseEnter?.(e);
              // 添加新功能
              console.log('元素悬停:', child.type);
            }
          });
        }
        return child;
      });

      return React.cloneElement(elements, {}, modifiedChildren);
    }
  };
}

// 状态获取示例
function withStore(WrappedComponent) {
  return class extends WrappedComponent {
    someMethod() {
      // 可以访问 WrappedComponent 的所有方法
      console.log('State:', this.state);
      console.log('Props:', this.props);
    }

    render() {
      return super.render();
    }
  };
}

// 使用反向继承
@withLogger
@withLoading
@withChildrenModifier
class MyComponent extends React.Component {
  state = { data: [] };

  componentDidMount() {
    this.fetchData();
  }

  fetchData = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/data');
      const data = await res.json();
      this.setState({ data });
    } catch (error) {
      this.setState({ error });
    }
  };

  render() {
    return (
      <div className="my-component">
        <h1>标题</h1>
        {this.state.data.map(item => (
          <div key={item.id}>{item.name}</div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
}

          <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
          <Route path="/about" element={<About />} />
        </Routes>
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

错误边界 ErrorBoundary

jsx
class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error('Error:', error, errorInfo);
    logErrorToService(error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return this.props.fallback || <div>出错了</div>;
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

// 使用
<ErrorBoundary fallback={<div>页面出错了</div>}>
  <MyComponent />
</ErrorBoundary>

Transition 和 DeferredValue

import { useState, useTransition, useDeferredValue } from 'react';

function SearchApp() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const deferredQuery = useDeferredValue(query);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    startTransition(() => {
      setQuery(e.target.value);
    });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <input value={query} onChange={handleChange} />
      {isPending && <div>加载中...</div>}
      <SearchResults query={deferredQuery} />
    </div>
  );
}

11. immutable及immer ​

Immutable.js 完整指南

jsx
import { Map, List, Set, OrderedMap, fromJS } from 'immutable';

// 1. Map - 对象
const map1 = Map({ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 });
const map2 = map1.set('b', 50);  // 返回新 Map，原 Map 不变
console.log(map1.get('a'));  // 1
console.log(map2.get('a'));  // 1
console.log(map1.get('b'));  // 2
console.log(map2.get('b'));  // 50

// 链式操作
const map3 = map1
  .set('b', 50)
  .set('d', 4)
  .delete('a');
console.log(map3.toJS());  // { b: 50, c: 3, d: 4 }

// 合并
const map4 = Map({ e: 5, f: 6 });
const merged = map1.merge(map4);  // { a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, e: 5, f: 6 }
const deepMerged = map1.mergeDeep(map4);  // 深度合并

// 嵌套结构
const nested = Map({
  user: Map({ name: 'John', age: 30 }),
  posts: List(['post1', 'post2', 'post3'])
});

nested.getIn(['user', 'name']); // 'John'
const updated = nested.setIn(['user', 'age'], 31);
console.log(nested.getIn(['user', 'age']));  // 30
console.log(updated.getIn(['user', 'age']));  // 31

// 2. List - 数组
const list1 = List([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);
const list2 = list1.push(6);  // [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
const list3 = list1.pop();  // [1, 2, 3, 4]
const list4 = list1.concat([6, 7]);  // [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
const list5 = list1.update(0, x => x * 10);  // [10, 2, 3, 4, 5]
const list6 = list1.insert(2, 99);  // [1, 2, 99, 3, 4, 5]

// 切片
const sliced = list1.slice(1, 4);  // [2, 3, 4]

// Map/Filter
const doubled = list1.map(x => x * 2);  // [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
const evens = list1.filter(x => x % 2 === 0);  // [2, 4]
const found = list1.find(x => x > 3);  // 4
const foundIndex = list1.findIndex(x => x > 3);  // 3

// 3. 与 JS 互转
const jsObj = { a: 1, b: 2 };
const immutableMap = Map(jsObj);  // JS -> Immutable
const backToJs = immutableMap.toJS();  // Immutable -> JS
const toJson = JSON.stringify(immutableMap);  // 转 JSON

// 4. 在 React 中使用
import { useSelector, shallowEqual } from 'react-redux';

const selector = (state) => state.get('user');

// 使用 Immutable.js
const user = useSelector(selector);

// 使用 selectorFactory
import { createSelector } from 'reselect';

const userSelector = createSelector(
  [(state) => state.get('user')],
  [(user) => user]
);

immer 完整指南

jsx
import { produce, enablePatches, applyPatches, original } from 'immer';

// 1. 基础用法
const state = {
  user: {
    name: 'John',
    age: 30,
    address: {
      city: 'Beijing',
      street: '123 Main St'
    }
  },
  posts: [
    { id: 1, title: 'Post 1', comments: ['comment1'] },
    { id: 2, title: 'Post 2', comments: [] }
  ]
};

// draft 是草稿状态，可以直接修改
const nextState = produce(state, (draft) => {
  draft.user.age = 31;  // 修改嵌套属性
  draft.user.address.city = 'Shanghai';  // 深度修改
  draft.posts.push({ id: 3, title: 'Post 3', comments: [] });  // 添加数组元素
  draft.posts[0].comments.push('comment2');  // 修改数组元素
  draft.posts = draft.posts.filter(p => p.id !== 1);  // 删除数组元素
});

// 原对象不变
console.log(state.user.age);  // 30
console.log(nextState.user.age);  // 31

// 2. 返回新值
const incrementAge = produce((draft) => {
  return draft.user.age + 1;  // 返回值替换整个状态
});

// 3. 在 useReducer 中使用
const initialState = {
  user: null,
  posts: [],
  loading: false,
  error: null
};

function reducer(state, action) {
  return produce(state, (draft) => {
    switch (action.type) {
      case 'FETCH_START':
        draft.loading = true;
        draft.error = null;
        break;
      case 'FETCH_SUCCESS':
        draft.loading = false;
        draft.user = action.payload.user;
        draft.posts = action.payload.posts;
        break;
      case 'FETCH_ERROR':
        draft.loading = false;
        draft.error = action.payload;
        break;
      case 'ADD_POST':
        draft.posts.push(action.payload);
        break;
      case 'UPDATE_POST':
        const postIndex = draft.posts.findIndex(p => p.id === action.payload.id);
        if (postIndex !== -1) {
          draft.posts[postIndex] = action.payload;
        }
        break;
      case 'DELETE_POST':
        draft.posts = draft.posts.filter(p => p.id !== action.payload);
        break;
      case 'ADD_COMMENT':
        const idx = draft.posts.findIndex(p => p.id === action.payload.postId);
        if (idx !== -1) {
          draft.posts[idx].comments.push(action.payload.comment);
        }
        break;
    }
  });
}

// 4. patches 和恢复（时间旅行调试）
enablePatches();

const [nextState, patches, inversePatches] = produce(state, (draft) => {
  draft.user.age = 31;
}, (patches, inversePatches) => {
  // 收集 patches
  console.log('patches:', patches);
  console.log('inversePatches:', inversePatches);
});

// 使用 patches 恢复
const restoredState = applyPatches(state, inversePatches);

// 5. original 获取原始值
const withOriginal = produce((draft) => {
  const currentAge = draft.user.age;
  const originalAge = original(draft.user).age;
  console.log('Current:', currentAge, 'Original:', originalAge);  // 31, 30
  draft.user.age = 32;
});

// 6. 在 React Query 中使用
import { useQuery, useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';

function useImmerQuery(key, fetcher) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: key,
    queryFn: fetcher,
    select: useCallback(
      (data) => produce(data, (draft) => {
        // 转换数据
      }),
      []
    ),
  });
}

// 输入值由 React 控制
function ControlledInput() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');

  return (
    <input
      value={value}
      onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
    />
  );
}

// 受控select
function ControlledSelect() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState('apple');

  return (
    <select value={selected} onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}>
      <option value="apple">苹果</option>
      <option value="banana">香蕉</option>
    </select>
  );
}

// 受控checkbox
function ControlledCheckbox() {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState(false);

  return (
    <input
      type="checkbox"
      checked={checked}
      onChange={(e) => setChecked(e.target.checked)}
    />
  );
}

  );
}

React 核心思想

  1. 组件化：一切皆为组件

import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';

function App() {
  const [count, setCount] = React.useState(0);

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Hello React</h1>
      <p>计数: {count}</p>
      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>
        点击
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <App />
  </React.StrictMode>
);

// 状态声明
function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [user, setUser] = useState({ name: '', age: 0 });

  // 更新状态
  const increment = () => {
    setCount(count + 1);
    // 或函数式更新
    setCount(prev => prev + 1);
  };

  const updateUser = () => {
    setUser(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      name: 'John',
      age: 31
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p>{count}</p>
      <p>{user.name}</p>
      <button onClick={increment}>+</button>
      <button onClick={updateUser}>更新用户</button>
    </div>
  );
}

class MyComponent extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { count: 0 };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromProps(props, state) {
    // 在渲染前调用，返回新状态或null

  }

  componentDidMount() {
    // DOM 已挂载，可进行 DOM 操作
    console.log('组件已挂载');
    this.fetchData();
  }

  render() {
    return <div>{this.state.count}</div>;
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

function MyComponent({ initialCount }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(initialCount);

  // 挂载时执行
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('挂载');

    // 返回清理函数
    return () => {
      console.log('卸载');
    };
  }, []);

  // 更新时执行
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('count 更新:', count);
    return () => {
      console.log('count 更新前清理');
    };
  }, [count]);

  return <div>{count}</div>;
}

五、状态管理 ​

20. Mobx ​

核心概念

概念说明
observable可观察状态
action修改状态的方法
computed计算属性
reaction副作用反应

完整创建 Store

jsx
import { makeAutoObservable, runInAction, reaction } from 'mobx';
import { observer } from 'mobx-react-lite';

class UserStore {
  // observable 状态 - 可观察的数据
  name = 'John';
  age = 30;
  posts = [];
  isLoading = false;
  error = null;

  constructor() {
    // 自动将属性变为可观察，将方法变为 action
    makeAutoObservable(this);
  }

  // computed 计算属性 - 基于现有状态计算得出
  get fullName() {
    return `用户: ${this.name}`;
  }

  get isAdult() {
    return this.age >= 18;
  }

  get postCount() {
    return this.posts.length;
  }

  get publishedPosts() {
    return this.posts.filter(post => post.isPublished);
  }

  // action 操作 - 修改状态的方法
  setName(name) {
    this.name = name;
  }

  setAge(age) {
    this.age = age;
  }

  // 异步 action
  async fetchPosts() {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.error = null;

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/posts');
      const posts = await response.json();

      runInAction(() => {
        this.posts = posts;
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      runInAction(() => {
        this.error = error.message;
        this.isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  addPost(post) {
    this.posts.push(post);
  }

  updatePost(postId, updates) {
    const post = this.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
    if (post) {
      Object.assign(post, updates);
    }
  }

  deletePost(postId) {
    this.posts = this.posts.filter(p => p.id !== postId);
  }

  // 批量更新
  updateUserInfo(info) {
    runInAction(() => {
      this.name = info.name;
      this.age = info.age;
      this.error = null;
    });
  }
}

// 创建 Store 实例
const userStore = new UserStore();

// 监听变化
reaction(
  () => userStore.posts.length,
  (postCount) => {
    console.log('帖子数量变化:', postCount);
    if (postCount > 10) {
      console.log('帖子数量超过10条');
    }
  },
  { delay: 500 }
);

// React 组件中使用
const UserProfile = observer(({ store }) => {
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{store.fullName}</h1>
      <p>年龄: {store.age}</p>
      <p>帖子数: {store.postCount}</p>
      <p>成年人: {store.isAdult ? '是' : '否'}</p>

      <button onClick={() => store.setAge(store.age + 1)}>生日++</button>
      <button onClick={() => store.fetchPosts()}>获取帖子</button>

      {store.isLoading && <div>加载中...</div>}
      {store.error && <div>错误: {store.error}</div>}

      <ul>
        {store.publishedPosts.map(post => (
          <li key={post.id}>{post.title}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
});

进阶用法 - Store 依赖注入

jsx
import { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import { runInAction } from 'mobx';

const StoreContext = createContext(null);

function StoreProvider({ stores, children }) {
  return (
    <StoreContext.Provider value={stores}>
      {children}
    </StoreContext.Provider>
  );
}

function useStore(storeName) {
  const stores = useContext(StoreContext);
  if (!stores[storeName]) {
    throw new Error(`Store ${storeName} not found`);
  }
  return stores[storeName];
}

// 严格模式 - 确保所有状态修改都在 action 中
import { configure } from 'mobx';

configure({
  enforceActions: 'always',
  computedRequiresReaction: true,
});

// 购物车完整示例
class CartStore {
  items = [];
  discount = 0;
  isProcessing = false;
  lastOrder = null;

  constructor() {
    makeAutoObservable(this, {
      checkout: action,
      addItem: action,
      removeItem: action,
    });
  }

  get totalAmount() {
    return this.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0);
  }

  get finalAmount() {
    return this.totalAmount * (1 - this.discount);
  }

  get itemCount() {
    return this.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
  }

  addItem(product) {
    const existing = this.items.find(item => item.id === product.id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.quantity += 1;
    } else {
      this.items.push({ ...product, quantity: 1 });
    }
  }

  removeItem(productId) {
    const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.id === productId);
    if (index !== -1) {
      if (this.items[index].quantity > 1) {
        this.items[index].quantity -= 1;
      } else {
        this.items.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  checkout() {
    if (this.items.length === 0) return Promise.resolve(null);

    runInAction(() => {
      this.isProcessing = true;
    });

    return fetch('/api/checkout', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ items: this.items })
    })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(order => {
        runInAction(() => {
          this.items = [];
          this.isProcessing = false;
          this.lastOrder = order;
        });
        return order;
      })
      .catch(error => {
        runInAction(() => {
          this.isProcessing = false;
          this.error = error.message;
        });
      });
  }
}

21. Redux详解 ​

三原则

  1. 单一数据源：整个应用的 state 存储在唯一的 store 中，整个应用只存在一个 store
  2. State 只读：只能通过 action 触发 state 变化，action 是唯一可以改变 state 的方式
  3. 纯函数修改：使用纯函数 reducer 根据 action 计算新 state，reducer 必须是纯函数

核心概念

jsx
// action - 描述要做什么（必须包含 type 属性）
const action = {
  type: 'ADD_TODO',
  payload: { id: 1, text: '学习 Redux' }
};

// action creator - 创建 action 的函数
const addTodo = (text) => ({
  type: 'ADD_TODO',
  payload: { id: Date.now(), text }
});

// reducer - 根据 action 计算新状态（必须是纯函数）
function reducer(state = [], action) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'ADD_TODO':
      // 必须返回新对象，不能修改原 state
      return [...state, action.payload];
    case 'DELETE_TODO':
      return state.filter(todo => todo.id !== action.payload);
    default:
      // 必须返回原 state
      return state;
  }
}

// store - 连接 action 和 reducer
import { createStore } from 'redux';
const store = createStore(reducer);

// 获取状态
store.getState();

// 派发 action（唯一能触发状态更新的方式）
store.dispatch({ type: 'ADD_TODO', payload: { id: 1, text: 'Hello' }});
store.dispatch(addTodo('World'));

// 订阅变化（当 state 变化时自动调用）
const unsubscribe = store.subscribe(() => {
  console.log('状态变化:', store.getState());
});

// 取消订阅
unsubscribe();

React-Redux 使用（V7.1+ Hooks API）

jsx
import { Provider, useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux';

// 1. 创建 store
import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
const store = configureStore({
  reducer: rootReducer
});

// 2. Provider 包裹应用
function App() {
  return (
    <Provider store={store}>
      <Counter />
      <UserList />
    </Provider>
  );
}

// 3. 在组件中使用 Hooks
function Counter() {
  // 选择器 - 获取 state
  const count = useSelector(state => state.counter.value);
  const userName = useSelector(state => state.user.name);

  // 复杂选择器
  const { count, doubleCount } = useSelector(state => ({
    count: state.counter.value,
    doubleCount: state.counter.value * 2
  }), shallowEqual); // 使用浅比较优化

  // dispatch - 派发 action
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  return (
    <div>
      <p>{count}</p>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'increment' })}>+</button>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch({ type: 'decrement' })}>-</button>
    </div>
  );
}

Redux Toolkit（推荐方式，现代化 Redux 开发）

jsx
import { createSlice, configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

// createSlice - 自动生成 action creators 和 action types
const counterSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'counter',
  initialState: { value: 0 },
  reducers: {
    // 自动生成 action creators: increment(), decrement(), incrementByAmount()
    increment: (state) => {
      // 可以直接修改 state（Immer 底层实现）
      state.value += 1;
    },
    decrement: (state) => {
      state.value -= 1;
    },
    incrementByAmount: (state, action) => {
      // action.payload 是传入的参数
      state.value += action.payload;
    },
  },
});

const { increment, decrement, incrementByAmount } = counterSlice.actions;

// 配置 store
const store = configureStore({
  reducer: {
    counter: counterSlice.reducer,
  },
});

// 使用
store.dispatch(increment());
store.dispatch(incrementByAmount(5));
console.log(store.getState()); // { counter: { value: 6 } }

createAsyncThunk - 处理异步逻辑

jsx
import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

// 创建异步 thunk
export const fetchUserById = createAsyncThunk(
  'users/fetchById',  // action type 前缀
  async (userId, { rejectWithValue }) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch');
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      return rejectWithValue(error.message);
    }
  }
);

const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'user',
  initialState: {
    entities: {},
    loading: 'idle',  // 'idle' | 'pending' | 'succeeded' | 'failed'
    error: null,
  },
  reducers: {
    clearError: (state) => {
      state.error = null;
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(fetchUserById.pending, (state) => {
        state.loading = 'pending';
        state.error = null;
      })
      .addCase(fetchUserById.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        state.loading = 'succeeded';
        // 存储用户数据
        state.entities[action.payload.id] = action.payload;
      })
      .addCase(fetchUserById.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.loading = 'failed';
        state.error = action.payload || 'Unknown error';
      });
  },
});

// 组件中使用
function UserProfile({ userId }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const user = useSelector(state => state.users.entities[userId]);
  const loading = useSelector(state => state.users.loading);
  const error = useSelector(state => state.users.error);

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(fetchUserById(userId));
  }, [dispatch, userId]);

  if (loading === 'pending') return <div>加载中...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>错误: {error}</div>;
  return <div>{user?.name}</div>;
}

RTK Query - 数据获取和缓存

jsx
import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

// 创建 API
const api = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'api',  // 在 store 中存放的位置
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: '/api' }),  // 基础 URL
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    // 查询端点
    getUser: builder.query({
      query: (id) => `users/${id}`,
      // 可选配置
      providesTags: (result, error, id) => [{ type: 'User', id }],
    }),
    getPosts: builder.query({
      query: () => 'posts',
      providesTags: (result) =>
        result
          ? [
              ...result.map(({ id }) => ({ type: 'Post', id })),
              { type: 'Post' },  // 用于缓存失效
            ]
          : [{ type: 'Post' }],
    }),
    // 修改端点
    createPost: builder.mutation({
      query: (newPost) => ({
        url: 'posts',
        method: 'POST',
        body: newPost,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: [{ type: 'Post' }],  // 缓存失效
    }),
    updatePost: builder.mutation({
      query: ({ id, ...rest }) => ({
        url: `posts/${id}`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: rest,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (result, error, { id }) => [{ type: 'Post', id }],
    }),
  }),
});

export const { useGetUserQuery, useGetPostsQuery, useCreatePostMutation } = api;

// 在 store 中配置
const store = configureStore({
  reducer: {
    [api.reducerPath]: api.reducer,
  },
  middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) =>
    getDefaultMiddleware().concat(api.middleware),
});

// 组件中使用 - 自动缓存管理
function UserList() {
  const { data: users, isLoading, isFetching } = useGetUsersQuery();
  const [createPost, { isLoading: isCreating }] = useCreatePostMutation();

  if (isLoading) return <div>加载中...</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      {users?.map(user => (
        <UserCard key={user.id} user={user} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

中间件

jsx
import { applyMiddleware, createStore } from 'redux';
import thunk from 'redux-thunk';
import logger from 'redux-logger';

// thunk - 支持异步 action
const store = createStore(
  reducer,
  applyMiddleware(thunk, logger)
);

// thunk 支持异步 action（返回函数）
function fetchUsers() {
  return (dispatch, getState) => {
    dispatch({ type: 'FETCH_USERS_REQUEST' });
    fetch('/api/users')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(users => dispatch({ type: 'FETCH_USERS_SUCCESS', payload: users }))
      .catch(error => dispatch({ type: 'FETCH_USERS_FAILURE', payload: error }));
  };
}

// 自定义中间件
const customMiddleware = (storeAPI) => (next) => (action) => {
  console.log('Before:', storeAPI.getState());
  const result = next(action);
  console.log('After:', storeAPI.getState());
  return result;
};

// 日志中间件
const loggerMiddleware = (storeAPI) => (next) => (action) => {
  console.group(action.type);
  console.log('Previous:', storeAPI.getState());
  console.log('Action:', action);
  const result = next(action);
  console.log('Next:', storeAPI.getState());
  console.groupEnd();
  return result;
};

22. redux状态管理详解 ​

Redux Toolkit 完整示例

jsx
// slices/userSlice.js
import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

export const fetchUserById = createAsyncThunk(
  'users/fetchById',
  async (userId, { rejectWithValue }) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch');
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      return rejectWithValue(error.message);
    }
  }
);

const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'user',
  initialState: {
    entities: {},
    loading: 'idle',
    error: null,
  },
  reducers: {
    addUser: (state, action) => {
      state.entities[action.payload.id] = action.payload;
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(fetchUserById.pending, (state) => {
        state.loading = 'pending';
      })
      .addCase(fetchUserById.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        state.loading = 'succeeded';
        state.entities[action.payload.id] = action.payload;
      })
      .addCase(fetchUserById.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.loading = 'failed';
        state.error = action.payload;
      });
  },
});

useReducer 适用场景

// 复杂状态逻辑
function reducer(state, action) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'FETCH_START':
      return { ...state, loading: true };
    case 'FETCH_SUCCESS':
      return { ...state, loading: false, data: action.payload };
    case 'FETCH_ERROR':
      return { ...state, loading: false, error: action.payload };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

function DataComponent() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, {
    loading: false,
    data: null,
    error: null
  });

  // 状态逻辑集中，便于维护
}

// 主题切换
const ThemeContext = createContext('light');

function App() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light');

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
      <Toolbar />
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

function Toolbar() {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useContext(ThemeContext);

  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => setTheme(t => t === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light')}
      style={{ background: theme === 'light' ? '#fff' : '#333' }}
    >
      切换主题
    </button>
  );
}

24. Zustand状态管理 ​

基础 Store

jsx
import { create } from 'zustand';

const useUserStore = create((set, get) => ({
  // 状态
  name: 'John',
  age: 30,
  posts: [],
  isLoading: false,

  // actions - 直接更新
  setName: (name) => set({ name }),
  setAge: (age) => set({ age }),

  // 批量更新
  updateUser: (info) => set({
    name: info.name,
    age: info.age
  }),

  // 基于当前状态更新
  incrementAge: () => set((state) => ({
    age: state.age + 1
  })),

  // 异步操作
  fetchPosts: async () => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const posts = await fetch('/api/posts').then(res => res.json());
      set({ posts, isLoading: false });
    } catch (error) {
      set({ error: error.message, isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  // 获取状态
  getPostById: (id) => get().posts.find(p => p.id === id),
}));

// 在组件中使用
function UserProfile() {
  const { name, age, posts, setName, incrementAge } = useUserStore();

  return (
    <div>
      <p>姓名: {name}</p>
      <p>年龄: {age}</p>
      <p>帖子数: {posts.length}</p>

      <button onClick={() => setName('Jane')}>改名为 Jane</button>
      <button onClick={incrementAge}>年龄++</button>
    </div>
  );
}

// 只订阅 posts 变化
function PostList() {
  const posts = useUserStore((state) => state.posts);

  return (
    <ul>
      {posts.map(post => (

      ))}
    </ul>

// 使用相等性比较函数优化
function PublishedPosts() {
  const publishedPosts = useUserStore(
    (state) => state.posts.filter(p => p.isPublished),
    (prev, next) => prev.length === next.length
  );

  return <div>已发布: {publishedPosts.length}</div>;
}

中间件使用

jsx
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { devtools, subscribeWithSelector, persist, createJSONStorage } from 'zustand/middleware';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';

// devtools - Redux DevTools 支持
const useStoreWithDevtools = create(
  devtools(
    (set) => ({
      count: 0,
      increment: () => set((state) => ({ count: state.count + 1 })),
    }),
    { name: 'CounterStore' }
  )
);

// subscribeWithSelector - 支持选择器订阅
const useStore = create(
  subscribeWithSelector(
    (set) => ({
      count: 0,
      increment: () => set((state) => ({ count: state.count + 1 })),
    })
  )
);

// 订阅特定变化
useStore.subscribe(
  (state) => state.count,
  (count, prevCount) => {
    console.log(`count 变化: ${prevCount} -> ${count}`);
  }
);

// persist - 本地存储持久化
const useAuthStore = create(
  persist(
    (set, get) => ({
      token: null,
      user: null,

      setAuth: (token, user) => set({ token, user }),
      logout: () => set({ token: null, user: null }),
      isAuthenticated: () => !!get().token,
    }),
    {
      name: 'auth-storage',
      storage: createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage),
      partialize: (state) => ({
        // 只持久化部分状态
        token: state.token,
        user: state.user
      }),
    }
  )
);

// 自定义中间件
const logger = (config) => (set, get, api) =>
  config(
    (...args) => {
      console.log('状态更新:', args);
      set(...args);
    },
    get,
    api
  );

const useLoggedStore = create(
  logger((set) => ({
    count: 0,
    increment: () => set((state) => ({ count: state.count + 1 })),
  }))
);

切片模式 - 分割大型 Store

jsx
// 创建各个 slice
const createCounterSlice = (set, get) => ({
  count: 0,
  increment: () => set({ count: get().count + 1 }),
  decrement: () => set({ count: get().count - 1 }),
  resetCount: () => set({ count: 0 }),
});

const createUserSlice = (set, get) => ({
  name: 'John',
  setName: (name) => set({ name }),
  getGreeting: () => `Hello, ${get().name}!`,
});

const createCartSlice = (set, get) => ({
  items: [],
  addItem: (item) => set((state) => ({
    items: [...state.items, item]
  })),
  getTotal: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0),
});

// 合并 slice
const useStore = create((set, get) => ({
  ...createCounterSlice(set, get),
  ...createUserSlice(set, get),
  ...createCartSlice(set, get),
}));

// 组件中使用
function App() {
  const count = useStore((s) => s.count);
  const name = useStore((s) => s.name);
  const items = useStore((s) => s.items);

  return (
    <div>
      <p>{count}</p>
      <p>{name}</p>
      <p>购物车: {items.length} 件商品</p>
    </div>
  );
}

带 TypeScript 的完整 Store

jsx
import { create } from 'zustand';
import { devtools } from 'zustand/middleware';

interface User {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  avatar?: string;
}

interface Post {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  authorId: string;
  isPublished: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
}

interface UserState {
  user: User | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  setUser: (user: User | null) => void;
  fetchUser: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  updateUser: (updates: Partial<User>) => void;
  clearError: () => void;
}

interface PostState {
  posts: Post[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  addPost: (post: Post) => void;
  updatePost: (id: string, updates: Partial<Post>) => void;
  deletePost: (id: string) => void;
  publishPost: (id: string) => void;
}

type AppState = UserState & PostState;

const useStore = create<AppState>()(
  devtools(
    (set, get) => ({
      // User State
      user: null,
      isLoading: false,
      error: null,

      setUser: (user) => set({ user }),

      fetchUser: async (id) => {
        set({ isLoading: true, error: null });
        try {
          const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${id}`);
          const user = await response.json();
          set({ user, isLoading: false });
        } catch (error) {
          set({ error: error.message, isLoading: false });
        }
      },

      updateUser: (updates) => {
        const currentUser = get().user;
        if (currentUser) {
          set({ user: { ...currentUser, ...updates } });
        }
      },

      clearError: () => set({ error: null }),

      // Post State
      posts: [],

      addPost: (post) => set((state) => ({
        posts: [...state.posts, post]
      })),

      updatePost: (id, updates) => set((state) => ({
        posts: state.posts.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, ...updates } : p)
      })),

      deletePost: (id) => set((state) => ({
        posts: state.posts.filter(p => p.id !== id)
      })),

      publishPost: (id) => set((state) => ({
        posts: state.posts.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, isPublished: true } : p)
      })),
    }),
    { name: 'AppStore' }
  )
);

// 组件中使用
function ProfilePage({ userId }: { userId: string }) {
  const { user, isLoading, error, fetchUser } = useStore();

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser(userId);
  }, [userId]);

  if (isLoading) return <div>加载中...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>错误: {error}</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{user?.name}</h1>
      <p>{user?.email}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

与 Redux 对比

特性ZustandRedux
API 复杂度简单，核心只有 create复杂，需要配置 store/reducer/action
学习曲线平缓，半小时入门陡峭，需要理解很多概念
Boilerplate很少较多，需要写很多模板代码
DevTools支持原生支持，功能更完善
性能优秀优秀
中间件有限丰富（redux-thunk, redux-saga等）
适用场景中小型应用、简单状态管理大型复杂应用、企业级项目
TypeScript 支持良好更好
社区生态较小庞大
Bundle Size~1kb~7kb

六、SSR 相关 ​

25. SSR方案的价值 ​

服务端渲染的优势

  1. SEO 优化

    • 搜索引擎爬虫可以直接抓取完整 HTML
    • 首屏内容更快被索引

  2. 首屏加载优化

    • 减少首屏渲染时间（FP/FCP）
    • HTML 直接展示，无需等待 JS 下载执行

  3. 服务端数据预取

    • 在服务端完成数据请求
    • 减少客户端请求数量

React SSR 方案

jsx
// Next.js App Router
export default async function Page() {
  // 服务端直接获取数据
  const data = await fetchData();

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{data.title}</h1>
      <p>{data.content}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

SSR 注意事项

jsx
// 1. 使用 window/document 需要进行判断
useEffect(() => {
  // 客户端执行
  const handleScroll = () => {};

  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
}, []);

// 2. 避免水合不匹配
// 服务端和客户端渲染结果必须一致
// 不要在 useEffect 中进行首次渲染

// 3. 数据序列化
// 传递数据给客户端
const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('initial-data').textContent);
